purpose: Prospective validation of the current strict strategy without tuning on short-run outcomes.

primaryHypothesis.definition: netPnlEur / plannedRiskEur for each closed strict paper trade, after modeled exchange costs
primaryHypothesis.falsificationRule: At n >= 50, if the upper bound of the approximate 95% CI for mean net R is <= 0, the frozen strategy is falsified.
primaryHypothesis.supportRule: At n >= 100, if the lower bound of the approximate 95% CI for mean net R is > 0, the frozen strategy has prospective evidence of positive expectancy.

aiShadowHypothesis.rule: AI never changes live signal validity during this protocol.
aiShadowHypothesis.measurement: Compare closed strict paper-trade outcomes by AI verdict and the counterfactual PnL if MATERIAL_RISK_FOUND reviews had been skipped, including all measured AI API costs.

riskReviewThresholds.note: Crossing this threshold triggers review; it does not automatically alter or stop the strategy.

changeControl.rule: Any change to the locked analysis-engine.js or paper-trader.js blob without registering a new protocol version sets evaluation status to PROTOCOL_CHANGED.

baselineAtRegistration.note: These pre-registration trades remain descriptive only and are excluded from prospective checkpoint decisions.
